footer.tagline: Discover your strengths, build your skills and take your next step: learning, career guidance and opportunities in one journey.
footer.disclaimer: This is a demonstration platform with fictional sample data. UNICEF Syria Youth Pathways is a proposed working name, not an approved programme. People, organisations, centres, vacancies and figures shown are illustrative.

home.title: Discover, learn and take your next step

hero.body: Explore learning, career guidance and opportunities to work, freelance or build a business.
hero.imageAlt: Young people working together in a bright training space

routes.title: One journey,
routes.body: Whether you want a steady job, your own business or flexible project work, you get a learning path built for that route, and you can change your mind at any time.
routes.hint: Keep scrolling to move through the routes

employment.title: Get ready for a job you want
employment.body: Understand what employers ask for, build an honest CV and practise interviews until you feel confident.
points: Read job adverts and match your skills
Build a one-page CV with real evidence
employment.alt: A young woman at a customer service desk

enterprise.title: Test and grow a business idea
enterprise.body: Talk to real customers, shape a simple business model and plan your first small experiment, step by step.
points: Find a customer problem worth solving
Sketch a business model and cash plan
Pitch your idea and get feedback
enterprise.alt: A young man repairing a phone at a small workshop

freelance.title: Find flexible and project work
freelance.body: Package what you are good at into a clear service, build sample work and write proposals clients understand.
points: Define a service you can deliver
Write a scoped proposal and timeline
freelance.alt: A young woman designing social media content on a laptop

journey.title: Five steps from curious to earning.
journey.body: Every step gives you something useful to keep, even before you find work.
journey.imageAlt: A mentor talking with a young learner
journey.caption: Trainers, mentors and AI coaches support you all the way.

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: A short scenario exercise shows how you like to work. There is no pass or fail.

choose.title: Choose your route
choose.body: Pick employment, entrepreneurship or freelancing, with clear reasons for each suggestion.

learn.title: Learn
learn.body: Follow a personal path of short online courses with practical tasks and certificates of completion.

support.title: Get support
support.body: Join centre sessions, book a mentor and practise with five AI coaches.

earn.title: Earn
earn.body: Apply to sample jobs, internships, freelance projects and enterprise support with your evidence ready.

featured.title: Short courses, real practice.
featured.body: Every course has four units, a practical task and a quick knowledge check. Start with these.

centres.title: Learn online, practise at a centre.
centres.body: Courses run online. Three sample training centres add in-person sessions for their cohorts.
centres.imageAlt: Learners in a training centre classroom
centres.badgeBody: Online courses plus centre sessions with a trainer.

events.title: Meet employers and clients.
events.body: Open events anyone with a profile can join.
events.done: You are registered for this event
events.note: Sample event. No live meeting is created.

employers.title: Hiring young talent?
employers.body: Post opportunities, see skills evidence and give feedback that improves training.

partners.title: Running a programme?
partners.body: Follow participation, learning and outcomes across your centres in one place.

final.title: Your next step starts here.
final.body: Create a profile in a few minutes and discover the career directions that may suit you.

prompt.title: Create your profile first
prompt.body: To enrol, save or apply for "{{item}}" you need a free profile. We will bring you straight back here afterwards.
prompt.point1: Your saved courses and applications stay in one place.
prompt.point2: You choose what employers can see.

explore.title: Explore training
explore.body: Browse short courses for every career route. No profile needed to look around.
explore.honest: All 16 sample courses are available online at your own pace. The governorate and centre filters show where a sample centre adds blended, in-person sessions to a course for its cohort.
explore.empty: Try removing a filter. Only a few courses have centre sessions in this sample.

course.missingBody: This course is not in the sample catalogue. Browse the full list instead.
course.enrolled: Enrolled. The course is now in your learning path.
course.allRoutes: Useful for all three career routes
course.outcomes: What you will be able to do
course.online: Online, at your own pace, on phone or computer.

opps.title: Sample opportunities
opps.body: See the kinds of jobs, internships, flexible work and enterprise support you could prepare for.
opps.honest: All organisations and opportunities are fictional samples. Applying in this demo does not send anything to a real employer.
opps.drafted: Started a draft application. Finish it from your Opportunities page.
opps.savedToast: Saved to your applications as a draft
opps.emptyTitle: No opportunities in this group yet
opps.emptyBody: Check another tab, or create a profile to be told when new sample opportunities appear.

partners.title: Work with young people on their way up.
partners.body: One shared platform connects training centres, employers and programme partners around each learner's journey.
partners.signIn: Sign in to a demo workspace

employers.title: For employers and clients
employers.body: Find motivated young people with evidence of what they can do.
points: Post jobs, internships and short freelance projects
Search candidates who chose to share their profile
See course evidence and practical work, never assessment scores or disability information
Move applications through clear stages and record confirmed starts
Share feedback that helps centres improve training

partners.title: For programme partners and centres
partners.body: Follow participation, learning and outcomes across your network.
points: Manage courses, cohorts, trainers and sessions
See outcomes reported by employers separately from learner reports
Filter reports by centre, programme, route and governorate

views.title: Each role sees only what it needs
views.body: Every sign-in opens a view scoped to that role. Nobody sees records outside their own centre, organisation or partner network.
views.trainer: Assigned cohorts only: applications, sessions, attendance and practical reviews.
views.employer: Own organisation only: its opportunities, applicants and placements.
views.centre: Own centre only: courses, participants, trainers and results.
views.partner: Own partner network: centres, programmes and outcomes.
views.unicef: National overview across partners, centres and governorates.
views.viewer: Optional read-only aggregate reports. Not a confirmed requirement.
views.privacy: Personal support needs, disability information and coaching notes are never shown to employers.

cta.title: See it from your side
cta.body: Open a demo workspace for a trainer, employer, centre, partner or UNICEF administrator.

register.title: Let's start your
register.returnNote: When you finish, we will take you back to the item you chose.
register.restored: We restored your saved draft. Passwords are never kept in a draft.
register.demoNote: This demo registration creates the sample learner Nour Hassan. Anything you enter stays on this device.
register.sampleDone: Nour's sample details added. Check each step, then create the profile.

intro.account: Your name, how we reach you and your preferred language.
intro.background: A little about you, so we can suggest the right learning.
intro.interests: What you enjoy and what you can already do.
intro.support: Optional. Tell us anything that helps you learn well.
intro.permissions: You decide how your profile is used and shared.

errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.contact: Enter a valid email address or mobile number.
errors.verify: Select Verify (demo) to confirm your contact details.
errors.interests: Choose at least one career interest.
errors.consent: Please confirm programme participation to continue.

account.name: Full name
account.contactHint: We use this to sign you in and send programme updates.
account.verifiedToast: Contact details marked as verified for the demo
account.noOtp: Demonstration only: no code or message is sent.

background.ageNote: Age eligibility for the programme is to be confirmed.
background.experienceHint: Paid work, volunteering, family business or projects all count.

interests.cvNote: Simulation: no file is opened or uploaded. A sample file name is attached to show how it works.

support.who: Only you, your assigned trainer and centre support staff can see support preferences. They are never shown to employers or clients, and you can change them at any time.
support.note: Anything else that would help you learn
support.noteHint: For example, a time of day that suits you, or a support need.
support.disabilityHint: Optional. Used only for inclusion reporting and support. Never shared with employers.

permissions.programme: I agree to take part in the programme
permissions.programmeBody: My trainer and centre can see my profile, learning progress, attendance and practical work to support me. Reports use combined numbers only.
permissions.employer: Show my profile to employers and clients
permissions.employerBody: You can switch this off at any time. Applying to an opportunity always shares your application with that organisation.
permissions.on: On: approved employers can find your profile in candidate search.
permissions.off: Off: employers only see what you send when you apply.
shared: Your CV, if you choose to attach it
hidden: Your contact details until you apply
permissions.sample: Use sample information only. This demonstration does not store real personal data.

success.title: Your profile is ready. Discover the career directions that may suit you.
success.body: A short scenario exercise of about 8 to 10 minutes. It supports exploration, has no pass or fail and does not decide admission or employment eligibility.
success.library: You can use the general course library at any time.
